note: Djibouti: Singaporeans enter without a visa; everyone else applies for an e-Visa (since 18 February 2018; a short stay of 15 to 90 days, USD 23), which the government recommends; a visa on arrival, which Timatic still lists for all, isn't modelled. Hong Kong's 14-day exemption (from Hong Kong's Immigration Department) isn't confirmed by Djibouti. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Djibouti
sources.said: All visitors to Djibouti must obtain either a visa on arrival to Djibouti, an electronic visa online or a visa from one of the Djiboutian diplomatic missions prior to arrival in Djibouti ... Djibouti's government recommends that travellers apply for an eVisa. ... Visitors can apply for a transit visa valid for 3 days or a single entry visit visa valid for 15-90 days.
